description: Siticone NetFrameworkUI is a modern UI library for .NET Framework 4.8 and above. Build fast, sleek, and high-performance WinForms desktop apps with hardware-accelerated, pixel-perfect controls—seamlessly integrated for a polished, modern experience.
releaseNotes:
Siticone UI - Key Improvements:

IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ BEFORE UPDATING:
• Securely back up your existing projects before updating.
• Read the changelog below carefully before updating your library version.
• Contact Siticone support before updating if you have questions or need clarification.
• Test the new version in a separate test project before applying it to a production project.


IMPROVEMENTS:
- Fixed theme colors not being applied correctly at runtime, including cases where the form or title bar could appear white even though the selected theme looked correct in the Visual Studio designer.

- Improved theme switching so the form background, title bar, text, control buttons, hover states and pressed states update consistently when the theme changes.

- Added support for automatically following the Windows light or dark appearance, with separate theme choices available for each mode.

- Added optional support for using the user's Windows accent color, allowing the form to blend more naturally with the operating system.

- Added Windows 11 backdrop effects, including Mica, Acrylic and Mica Alt, for applications that want a more modern Windows 11 appearance.

- Added Windows 11 rounded-corner support while safely retaining normal behavior on earlier versions of Windows.

- Significantly improved high-DPI and 4K display support so the title bar, control box buttons, icons and text scale more naturally instead of appearing unusually small or crowded.

- Increased and improved the default control box proportions so the minimize, maximize and close buttons have a more familiar Windows-like size and spacing.

- Improved the appearance and positioning of the title bar icons so they remain sharp, balanced and properly centered across different display scaling levels.

- Added independent sizing controls for the close, maximize, minimize, help, pin and settings icons, giving developers much finer control over the title bar appearance.

- Added customizable icon stroke thickness for the control box, making it easier to achieve lighter or stronger icon styling while maintaining consistent proportions.

- Improved the minimize, maximize, restore and close icons to provide a cleaner and more professional Windows-style appearance.

- Improved the help, pin-to-top and settings icons so they scale cleanly and remain visually balanced alongside the standard window controls.

- Added complete normal, hover and pressed color customization for individual title bar buttons, including close, maximize, minimize, help, pin-to-top and settings.

- Added more control over the title bar, including customizable height, title font, title padding, title text visibility, title icon visibility and title icon size.

- Improved title bar double-click behavior so users can naturally maximize and restore the window just like a standard Windows application.

- Improved window dragging so a simple click is no longer treated as an immediate drag, resulting in more natural clicking and double-clicking behavior.

- Fixed DragEntireForm so the form can genuinely be dragged from suitable areas throughout the form instead of effectively remaining limited to the title bar.

- Improved dragging from maximized and snapped states so the window restores underneath the mouse pointer in a more natural Windows-like manner.

- Added proper resizing for the borderless form from all edges and corners, making SiticoneForm behave much more like a standard resizable Windows Form.

- Added customizable resize-edge thickness so developers can control how easy the borderless window is to resize.

- Improved maximized window behavior so the form can respect the Windows working area and keep the taskbar visible.

- Added Windows-style drag-to-edge window snapping.

- Added snapping to the left half, right half, full working area and all four screen corners.

- Added an animated snap preview that shows where the form will be placed before the user releases the mouse.

- Added customization for the snap preview, including its color, border color, corner radius, border thickness, opacity, activation distance and animation speed.

- Added the ability to restore a snapped window to its previous size when the user drags it away from the snapped position.

- Added programmatic window snapping so applications can move a SiticoneForm directly into a supported screen region when needed.

- Added snap-related events so applications can respond when a snap region changes or after the form has been snapped.

- Added the ability to save the current window position, size and maximized state and restore them when the application is opened again.

- Improved saved window-position restoration so a window is not restored onto a monitor that is no longer connected.

- Added improved multi-monitor awareness for window positioning, snapping, maximizing and restoring.

- Improved automatic screen centering so forms open more reliably in the expected position.

- Added optional native window drop shadows for a more natural borderless-window appearance.

- Added a dedicated pin-to-top title bar button, making it easy for users to keep a window above other applications.

- Added pin-state tracking and notifications so applications can respond when a form is pinned or unpinned.

- Added optional Help and Settings buttons directly to the title bar, with events that applications can use to provide their own actions.

- Added individual visibility controls for the close, minimize, maximize, help, pin-to-top and settings buttons.

- Added optional close confirmation to help prevent users from accidentally closing an application.

- Added an optional close countdown that allows the close action to be delayed and visibly counted down before the window closes.

- Added the ability to completely prevent the title bar close button from closing the form when an application needs to control closing itself.

- Improved form fade-in and fade-out animations and added control over the animation duration.

- Added an optional rotating close icon hover effect for applications that want additional visual feedback.

- Improved visual feedback for title bar controls with clearer normal, hover, pressed and active states.

- Added convenient theme refresh and appearance refresh support so visual changes can be reapplied immediately when application settings change.

- Improved handling of manually customized colors so custom appearance settings can coexist more predictably with built-in themes.

- Added the ability to reset customized colors and return the form completely to the selected built-in theme.

- Improved dark-theme integration with Windows so dark SiticoneForm themes feel more consistent with the operating system.

- Reduced visual flickering and improved overall responsiveness during painting, resizing, hovering, dragging, snapping and animations.

- Improved rendering efficiency for frequently redrawn title bar elements, resulting in smoother interaction and lower unnecessary drawing overhead.

- Improved form stability during theme changes, DPI changes, monitor changes, resizing, maximizing, restoring and closing.

- Preserved compatibility with existing SiticoneForm projects and designer-generated code while extending the control with the new window-management and appearance capabilities.

- SiticoneForm is now a substantially more complete replacement for a standard borderless Windows Form, combining customizable theming with modern window behavior, high-DPI support, snapping, Windows 11 integration and enhanced title bar controls.
title: Siticone NetFramework UI
